description.summary: Making a grand performance, you forge several spectral instruments and musical notes into existence that copy the look of your target, creating shifting duplicates.
description.value: Making a grand performance, you forge several spectral instruments and musical notes into existence that copy the look of your target, creating shifting duplicates. The creature benefits from a 50% miss chance as if it had total concealment . Unlike actual total concealment, cadence orchestra does not prevent enemies from targeting the creature normally. True seeing reveals its true location and negates the miss chance. This song does not require the bard to continue a performance, once it has been performed the effects persist for the duration listed or until it is dismissed.
